title: Jigsaw in the time of pandemic
reason: Jigsaw collaborative-learning case report (one university course, moved online by COVID-19) evaluated by student perception surveys compared with the previous year. No platform-recorded indicator or activity product is related to success or a construct.

extraction.n_quote: given the larger number of surveyed students (last year 9 students, this year 12 students.
extraction.population: 3rd-year videogame design and development degree students, 1 course
extraction.notes: Authors call the correlations 'interesting, but hard to prove'. Survey respondents per year: 9 and 12.
